The build succeeds. The change is complete.

I made two edits to `rust/src/server/src/routes.rs`:

1. Added the import `use axum::extract::DefaultBodyLimit;`
2. Applied `router.layer(DefaultBodyLimit::max(32 * 1024 * 1024))` as the outermost layer in `build_router_with_options` (which is what `build_router` delegates to).

This overrides Axum's built-in ~2 MiB default body limit with a 32 MiB limit across all routes, including `POST /v1/chat/completions`. The layer is applied to the final assembled router so it covers every route, and the crate compiles cleanly.
